items.title: E-waste Management and Sustainable Computing (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of E-waste Management and Sustainable Computing (PDF 136, printed 132).

blocks.text: Electronic waste (e-waste) tab banta hai jab devices phenk diye jate ya badal diye jate hain. E-waste ko ghalat tareeqe se thikane lagana mahol aur insani sehat ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Sustainable computing mein electronic devices ko zimmedari se recycle karna, dobara use karna (reuse) aur kam karna (reduce) shamil hai. Kam bijli lene wale (energy-efficient) devices aur mahol dost tareeqe technology ka manfi asar kam karte hain. E-waste ka sahi intezam wasail bachata hai aur aloodgi kam se kam rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Recycling, reuse aur energy-efficient devices mahol ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: E-waste purane phone, charger, battery aur computer hain jo phenk diye jate hain. In mein aise madde (materials) hote hain jo mitti aur pani ko zehreela bana sakte hain. Is liye inhein kachre mein phenkne ke bajaye recycle, reuse (dobara istemal) ya repair karna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: E-waste kya hai aur sustainable computing ke teen tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Woh electronic devices jo phenk diye ya badal diye jayein. Sustainable computing: recycle, reuse aur devices ka kam istemal (reduce); saath mein energy-efficient devices.

items: E-waste ghalat tareeqe se phenkne par mahol aur sehat ko nuqsan.
Recycle, reuse, reduce aur energy-efficient devices.
